title: Tests: attachment validation (oversized, path traversal, malformed MIME, peer-supplied)
description:
What: Unit and integration tests verifying that malicious or malformed attachment inputs are rejected at all entry points.

Algorithm:
Test cases, each with zero-write assertion (check no DB row created on failure):
1. Upload: body exceeds 104_857_600 bytes → 413.
2. Message/set create: blobId with ../ → notCreated.
3. Message/set create: filename with ../../etc/passwd → notCreated.
4. Message/set create: contentType with newline → notCreated.
5. Message/set create: size > maxAttachmentBytes → notCreated.
6. Message/set create: sha256 wrong length → notCreated.
7. Message/set create: > 20 attachments → notCreated.
8. Message/set create: blobId not previously uploaded → notCreated.
9. Peer/deliver: malicious filename in attachment metadata → invalidArguments, no message row in DB.
10. Peer/deliver: oversized attachment size claim → invalidArguments, no message row.
11. Download: blobId with path traversal → 400.

Oracles: all expected responses are RFC 8620 JMAP error types or HTTP status codes; no DB writes occur on rejection.

Agent team: T writes all test cases; V runs cargo test --workspace + clippy.
